svg.title: Where I've worked: Bigstrum Solutions, software engineer, May 2026 to now; LetsLance, software development engineer, July 2025 to May 2026; Infrawave Solutions, full-stack intern, January to June 2025; IIIT Vadodara, B.Tech in computer science, 2021 to 2025.
svg.text: Release owner for a four-app production suite used on a factory floor: a
Flutter tablet app, an MIS portal, and a public website with its CMS.
Enterprise apps on Angular, Spring Boot and Keycloak. MFA is
mandatory and every access decision comes from central policy.
A Go service and a Tauri tray app for shift check-ins, with every
integration mocked so it runs locally on day one.
Architected a production fintech backend: UPI, cards, BBPS, virtual
Sole developer of Zonikk, a live industrial and commercial real-estate
Backend for 1,000+ student submissions with role-based access,
An event platform (Stripe, wallets, QR entry), a pharma CMS on Next.js
and S3, and a marketing platform's UI.
